title: Business as Usual
narrative: Your office is the same as always. Fluorescent lights. The hum of the coffee machine. Someone's passive-aggressive note about labelling food in the fridge.
On the TV in the corner, a news ticker scrolls: CIVIL UNREST IN DOWNTOWN. POLICE ADVISE AVOIDING THE AREA.
Your manager stops by your desk. The quarterly report is due by noon.

choices.text: Work on the report. Act normal.
Spend the morning researching the downtown situation instead.
Slip out early and head toward the disturbance to see it yourself.
